title: Soul Twisting/Skill history
wikitext:
{{skill history}}
== [[Feedback:Game_updates/20100225#Ritualist|February 25, 2010]] ==
* Changed attribute dependence to Spawning Power; changed functionality to "Elite Skill. For 5...37...45 seconds, your Binding Rituals cost 15 less Energy (minimum 10) and recharge instantly. Soul Twisting ends after 1...3...3 Binding Rituals."
